tasks.name: Prepare process design basis
tasks.description: Compile feed, product, capacity, on-stream factor, ambient and battery-limit conditions into the process design basis.

needs.info: capacity, on-stream factor, feed slate, product slate and product specifications
owner process standards and design philosophies (sparing, design margins)
site meteorological data: ambient max/min/design dry and wet bulb temperatures, elevation
project design basis (BOD) framework and units of measure

tasks.name: Characterise feed and set up assay in simulation
tasks.description: Build the feed characterisation (assay cuts, pseudo-components, contaminants) and blend cases in the simulation.

needs.info: crude/feed assays: TBP/distillation curves, density, sulfur, metals, salts, naphthenic acid (TAN), light-ends analysis
feed blend cases and design/check feeds
process design basis feed slate and design cases (PROC-I010)

tasks.name: Run screening simulations of configuration options
tasks.description: Simulate candidate configurations at screening level to estimate yields, key duties and utility demand.

needs.info: feed characterisation and property package (PROC-I020)
process design basis capacity and product specs (PROC-I010)
candidate configurations and business case constraints

tasks.name: Prepare block flow diagrams
tasks.description: Draw block flow diagrams per option showing units, main streams and overall balances.

needs.info: screening case results: unit blocks and overall stream flows (PROC-I030)
existing site units and offsite interfaces (brownfield tie points)

tasks.name: Prepare screening equipment list with key sizes
tasks.description: List major equipment per option with order-of-magnitude sizes for factored estimating.

needs.info: screening case duties and flows (PROC-I030)
typical equipment sizing rules and cost curves for factored estimates

tasks.name: Develop and simulate FEL2 alternatives
tasks.description: Simulate the shortlisted alternatives including heat integration and design/turndown cases.

needs.info: feed characterisation (PROC-I020)
block flow diagrams per option (PROC-I040)
shortlisted alternatives and evaluation criteria
licensor/technology yield and performance data for proprietary sections

tasks.name: Evaluate technology and licensor process offers
tasks.description: Compare licensor/technology offers on yields, utilities, catalyst, guarantees and process risk.

needs.info: licensor proposals: yields, utilities, catalyst and chemical consumption, guarantees, references
licensor bid tabulation and commercial terms
alternative case balances for normalisation (PROC-I060)

tasks.name: Prepare process input to select decision
tasks.description: Rank alternatives on process merit and document the recommended configuration.

needs.info: alternative case balances (PROC-I060) and technology evaluation (PROC-I070)
Class 4/5 cost and schedule per alternative
HAZID and inherent safety ranking per alternative
economic evaluation criteria and weighting

tasks.name: Define utility and offsite basis
tasks.description: Define utility systems, supply conditions and offsite tankage/interconnection requirements.

needs.info: existing utility capacities and conditions (steam levels, CW, air, N2, fuel gas, power)
alternative utility demand (PROC-I060)
available grid power and supply voltage levels
environmental limits on effluents, emissions and water use

tasks.name: Define process layout requirements
tasks.description: Set process requirements on layout: elevations for gravity flow and NPSH, adjacency, segregation and access for operation.

needs.info: preliminary plot plan and equipment arrangement
selected configuration and PFDs (PROC-I080, PROC-I120)
spacing and separation requirements from siting study

tasks.name: Build and calibrate rigorous simulation
tasks.description: Build the rigorous unit model with column internals, exchangers and recycles, and calibrate to licensor or plant data.

needs.info: selected configuration (PROC-I080) and feed characterisation (PROC-I020)
plant test-run data or reference unit data for calibration (brownfield)
licensor process design package: heat and material balance, operating conditions

tasks.name: Prepare heat and material balance
tasks.description: Extract and issue stream data per design case from the simulation.

needs.info: calibrated simulation for all design cases (PROC-I100)
approval of design and check cases

tasks.name: Prepare process flow diagrams
tasks.description: Draw PFDs with equipment, main control loops and stream numbers tied to the stream table.

needs.info: stream data and stream numbering (PROC-I110)
control philosophy main loops (PROC-I230)
equipment numbering procedure / tag format

tasks.name: Set design pressures and temperatures
tasks.description: Build the pressure profile and set design and minimum design pressure/temperature per equipment and line system.

needs.info: stream data operating P/T per case (PROC-I110)
rotating equipment shut-off head (PROC-I150) and relief settings (PROC-I250)
pump and compressor shut-off pressures from vendor curves
design margin and MDMT philosophy

tasks.name: Size vessels and columns
tasks.description: Size separators, drums and columns: diameter, height, nozzles, internals and hydraulics.

needs.info: stream data and design cases (PROC-I110, PROC-I111)
tray/packing vendor hydraulic ratings
design pressure/temperature basis (PROC-I130)

tasks.name: Define rotating equipment process duties
tasks.description: Calculate pump and compressor duties, differential head, NPSHa and operating range.

needs.info: stream data: flow, density, viscosity, vapour pressure (PROC-I110)
suction and discharge line lengths and fittings from layout
process layout elevations (PROC-I095)

tasks.name: Design heat exchangers thermally
tasks.description: Run thermal design/rating of shell-and-tube exchangers and air coolers from the simulation duties.

needs.info: stream data and exchanger duties per case (PROC-I110)
fouling factors and allowable pressure drops from design basis (PROC-I010)
TEMA type, tube length/diameter preferences and plot constraints
plot space and bundle pull area for exchangers

tasks.name: Prepare equipment list process data
tasks.description: Issue the process data columns of the equipment list (duty, size, design conditions).

needs.info: sizing results for vessels, exchangers, rotating equipment (PROC-I140, PROC-I150, PROC-I155)
design P/T basis (PROC-I130)
mechanical equipment list with tags and equipment types

tasks.name: Prepare static equipment process datasheets
tasks.description: Prepare process datasheets for vessels, columns, drums and tanks.

needs.info: vessel/column sizing (PROC-I140) and design P/T (PROC-I130)
corrosion-relevant process data (PROC-I112)
fire case and tank emission requirements

tasks.name: Prepare heat transfer equipment process datasheets
tasks.description: Prepare process datasheets for shell-and-tube exchangers, air coolers, plate exchangers and fired heaters.

needs.info: EDR thermal design (PROC-I155)
stream data for heater duty and fuel (PROC-I110)
NOx/CO emission limits for fired equipment

tasks.name: Prepare rotating equipment process datasheets
tasks.description: Prepare process datasheets for pumps, compressors and blowers.

needs.info: rotating equipment process duties (PROC-I150)
corrosion-relevant process data (PROC-I112)

tasks.name: Prepare package process specifications
tasks.description: Specify process duty and battery limits for packaged units (e.g. chemical injection, nitrogen, air, water treatment).

needs.info: battery-limit and utility conditions (PROC-I015, PROC-I090)
chemical consumption (PROC-I275)
package scope split and requisition structure

tasks.name: Size lines and run hydraulics
tasks.description: Size process and utility lines and check pressure drop, velocity, two-phase regime and erosion.

needs.info: stream data (PROC-I110)
piping class pipe schedules and internal diameters
routed line lengths and fittings from 3D model for critical lines

tasks.name: Develop P&IDs (process content)
tasks.description: Draw P&IDs in SPID with equipment, lines, valves, instruments and control from PFDs and sizing.

needs.info: PFDs and equipment process duties (PROC-I120, PROC-I160)
line sizing results (PROC-I190)
control philosophy and trip schedule (PROC-I230, PROC-I235)
piping classes and valve symbols / specialty items
instrument tag format and typical instrument symbols
vendor package P&ID boundaries and nozzle arrangements
P&ID legend and drafting standards

tasks.name: Prepare line list process data
tasks.description: Enter line process data against P&ID lines for the line list.

needs.info: stream data per line (PROC-I110)
design P/T basis (PROC-I130) and line sizing (PROC-I190)
P&ID line numbers (PROC-I200)

tasks.name: Prepare instrument process data
tasks.description: Provide process conditions for each instrument and control valve tag for instrument sizing and datasheets.

needs.info: stream data at instrument location (PROC-I110)
P&ID instrument tags (PROC-I200)
instrument index tags and data-request templates from SI

tasks.name: Prepare control philosophy and control narratives
tasks.description: Define the control strategy and write control narratives per unit section.

needs.info: P&IDs and operating cases (PROC-I200, PROC-I111)
control system architecture and advanced control capability
operations input on control preferences and alarm philosophy

tasks.name: Define trips, interlocks and process input to SIF
tasks.description: List trips and permissives with initiators, actions and set points as process input to C&E and LOPA.

needs.info: HAZOP-ready P&IDs and control philosophy (PROC-I201, PROC-I230)
HAZOP recommendations and LOPA SIF requirements
design P/T and relief settings (PROC-I130, PROC-I250)

tasks.name: Prepare operating philosophy
tasks.description: Define operating modes, sparing, turndown, start-up/shutdown and maintenance isolation philosophy.

needs.info: operations staffing, maintenance and shutdown interval philosophy
design and operating cases (PROC-I111)

tasks.name: Calculate relief loads and size relief devices
tasks.description: Identify relief scenarios per device, calculate loads and size PSVs and rupture discs.

needs.info: HAZOP-ready P&IDs and design P/T (PROC-I201, PROC-I130)
stream data and simulation for relieving conditions (PROC-I100)
vessel wetted areas, volumes and insulation for fire case
inlet and outlet line routing lengths for PSV inlet loss and built-up back pressure
certified exchanger/pump/compressor data for tube rupture and blocked outlet cases

tasks.name: Run flare and blowdown hydraulics
tasks.description: Model the flare network for governing scenarios and run depressuring/blowdown studies.

needs.info: relief load summary and coincident scenarios (PROC-I250)
flare header isometrics/routing lengths and fittings
global flare load scenarios and radiation limits
vessel volumes and metal masses for depressuring

tasks.name: Prepare utility balances and consumption lists
tasks.description: Compile utility consumption per consumer and balance each utility system for normal and peak cases.

needs.info: stream data and equipment duties (PROC-I110, PROC-I160)
electrical load list for power summary cross-check
vendor-stated utility consumptions for packages (seal flush, cooling, purge, power)
utility and offsite basis (PROC-I090)

tasks.name: Prepare chemical and catalyst consumption list
tasks.description: List chemicals, catalysts and adsorbents with consumption, first fill and storage needs.

needs.info: licensor/chemical vendor dosing rates and catalyst volumes
stream data for dosing basis (PROC-I110)

tasks.name: Prepare effluent and emissions summary
tasks.description: Summarise liquid effluents, air emissions and wastes for environmental studies and permitting.

needs.info: stream data for effluent/vent streams (PROC-I110)
fired heater fuel and duties (PROC-I177)
permit limits and reporting format

tasks.name: Prepare process input to safety studies
tasks.description: Provide fluid and inventory data for hazardous area classification, consequence modelling and QRA.

needs.info: stream data and equipment inventories (PROC-I110, PROC-I140)
isolatable segment definition and release scenarios

tasks.name: Prepare process description and design report
tasks.description: Write the process description and process design report summarising basis, cases and design decisions.

needs.info: design basis, H&MB, PFDs, equipment duties (PROC-I010, PROC-I110, PROC-I120, PROC-I160)
HAZID/HAZOP key outcomes affecting process design

tasks.name: Participate in HAZOP and close process actions
tasks.description: Present P&IDs at HAZOP/LOPA, then respond to and close process-owned actions.

needs.info: HAZOP worksheets and recommendations assigned to process
LOPA results and required SIL per SIF
HAZOP-ready P&IDs (PROC-I201)

tasks.name: Process input to technical bid evaluations
tasks.description: Check vendor offers against process datasheets and state process acceptability.

needs.info: bid packages and technical clarification register
vendor proposals: performance curves, guaranteed duties, utility consumption, deviations
technical bid tabulation template and evaluation criteria

tasks.name: Review vendor data against process duties
tasks.description: Review vendor drawings and data for process compliance and return comments.

needs.info: vendor drawings and data: performance curves, rating sheets, P&IDs of packages, control narratives
vendor document review routing and status codes
process datasheets (PROC-I170 to PROC-I185)

tasks.name: Reconcile simulation with certified vendor data
tasks.description: Rerun the model with certified equipment performance and update the H&MB and affected process data.

needs.info: certified pump curves and NPSHr from vendor data
certified exchanger rating sheets and fired heater performance
certified compressor performance maps and settle-out data
final tray/packing hydraulic ratings
calibrated simulation (PROC-I100)

tasks.name: Respond to technical queries and holds
tasks.description: Answer process technical queries from other disciplines and vendors and release process holds.

needs.info: technical queries on datasheets and vendor deviations
queries on instrument process data and set points
queries on line routing requirements, slopes and specialty items
hold list and interface register entries assigned to process

tasks.name: Review instrument and control valve sizing
tasks.description: Review control valve, flow element and PSV sizing outputs against process data and controllability.

needs.info: control valve sizing results: Cv, trim, noise, rangeability
flow element sizing and instrument datasheets
PSV vendor-selected orifice and datasheets (if I&C owned)

tasks.name: Review 3D model and isometrics for process requirements
tasks.description: Check model and critical isometrics for slopes, pockets, symmetry, elevations and process access.

needs.info: 3D model review sessions and critical-line isometrics
process layout requirements and critical-line flags (PROC-I095, PROC-I190)

tasks.name: Define tie-in process conditions
tasks.description: Specify process conditions and isolation requirements at each tie-in to existing facilities.

needs.info: tie-in list with locations and line numbers
existing line process conditions and shutdown windows

tasks.name: Update P&IDs to IFD and IFC
tasks.description: Incorporate HAZOP markups, vendor data and discipline comments and issue P&IDs IFD then IFC.

needs.info: HAZOP P&ID markups (PROC-I301) and as-designed H&MB (PROC-I315)
certified vendor package P&IDs and nozzle data
instrument tag and loop updates from SI (correlated by hand)
P&ID-to-model consistency report via SPF
LOPA/SIL outcomes and HAZOP close-out status
P&ID review comments

tasks.name: Assess process impact of changes
tasks.description: Assess process impact of change requests and deviations and state required design updates.

needs.info: change requests and deviation notices
scope changes and operations requests

tasks.name: Prepare operating manual process input
tasks.description: Write process sections of the operating manual: description, limits, control and safeguarding.

needs.info: IFC P&IDs, control narratives, trip schedule (PROC-I341, PROC-I231, PROC-I235)
vendor operating and maintenance manuals for packages
operating manual template and operations review

tasks.name: Prepare process input to systemization
tasks.description: Mark process systems and subsystems on P&IDs for systemization and commissioning sequence.

needs.info: systemization rules and system numbering
IFC P&IDs (PROC-I341)

tasks.name: Prepare commissioning process requirements
tasks.description: Define flushing, drying, purging, leak test media, catalyst loading and initial fill requirements per system.

needs.info: commissioning plan and system list
vendor pre-commissioning and catalyst loading requirements
chemical and catalyst first-fill quantities (PROC-I275)

tasks.name: Prepare start-up, shutdown and emergency procedures
tasks.description: Write initial start-up, normal start-up/shutdown and emergency shutdown procedures.

needs.info: operating manual process input (PROC-I350)
cause and effect matrix and DCS/SIS configuration (trip and permissive logic)
commissioning sequence and system handover dates
operations procedure format and review

tasks.name: Respond to field RFIs and review field changes
tasks.description: Answer process-related RFIs and assess field changes for process impact.

needs.info: RFIs and field change requests with markups
field-routed small-bore and drain/vent changes

tasks.name: Support commissioning and start-up
tasks.description: Provide process engineers at site to support commissioning, troubleshoot and tune the unit to design.

needs.info: commissioning punch items and test records with process deficiencies
start-up plant data (DCS historian)
loop tuning status and alarm settings

tasks.name: Prepare and run performance test
tasks.description: Define the performance/guarantee test procedure, run the test and evaluate results against guarantees.

needs.info: contract guarantees and acceptance criteria
licensor test procedure and guarantee correction curves
plant data and lab analyses during test run

tasks.name: Incorporate as-built redlines into P&IDs
tasks.description: Update P&IDs and line process data to as-built from field redlines and commissioning changes.

needs.info: as-built redline P&IDs
commissioning changes and set point changes
IFC P&IDs (PROC-I341)

items.name: Process design basis
items.content: Capacity, turndown, on-stream factor, feed and product specifications, design margins, ambient design conditions, sparing philosophy, design cases.

items.name: Battery-limit conditions
items.content: Per battery-limit stream: pressure, temperature, flow range, composition at import/export points (feeds, products, utilities, flare, effluents).

items.name: Feed characterisation basis
items.content: Pseudo-component set, assay cuts and properties, blend cases, property package selection, contaminant distribution basis.

items.name: Screening case results
items.content: Per option: product yields and qualities, major heater/exchanger duties, column count, power and fuel demand, CO2 estimate.

items.name: Block flow diagrams
items.content: Unit blocks, main feed/product/intermediate streams, overall material balance and capacities per option.

items.name: Screening equipment list
items.content: Equipment type, count, key size parameter (duty, diameter, flow, power), material class per option for Class 5 estimate.

items.name: Alternative case balances
items.content: Per alternative: overall H&MB, product yields, heat integration (pinch/target), utility demand, major equipment duties.

items.name: Technology evaluation (process)
items.content: Normalised licensor comparison: yields, utilities, catalyst life, guarantee basis, maturity and process risks, recommendation.

items.name: Selected process configuration
items.content: Agreed configuration, unit capacities, technology choice, key design cases and reasons for selection.

items.name: Utility and offsite basis
items.content: Utility supply/return conditions (P, T, quality) per system, availability, tankage days, interconnecting lines, flare system basis.

items.name: Process layout requirements
items.content: Minimum elevations (NPSHa, thermosiphon, gravity drain), close-coupling, slope/no-pocket lines, equipment adjacency and operating access needs.

items.name: Calibrated simulation model
items.content: Rigorous HYSYS case per design case (summer/winter, max/min throughput, start-of-run/end-of-run), calibration notes.

items.name: Stream data
items.content: Per stream and case: flow (mass, molar, std vol), P, T, vapour fraction, composition, density, viscosity, MW, Cp, thermal conductivity, surface tension.

items.name: Design and operating case list
items.content: Design, check, turndown, start-up and upset cases with defining conditions and which equipment each governs.

items.name: Corrosion-relevant process data
items.content: Per circuit: H2S, CO2, chlorides, ammonia, free water, naphthenic acid, sulfur species, oxygen, operating T/P for corrosion and material selection.

items.name: Process flow diagrams
items.content: Major equipment with tags and duties, main lines with stream numbers, main control loops, stream table extract, utility interfaces.

items.name: Design pressure and temperature basis
items.content: Per system/equipment: max/min operating and design pressure, design and minimum design metal temperature, steam-out and vacuum conditions, settle-out pressure.

items.name: Vessel and column process sizing
items.content: ID, T/T, liquid levels (LL/LLL/NLL/HLL/HHLL), residence times, nozzle duties, internals type and count, tray loading and flood margin.

items.name: Rotating equipment process duties
items.content: Per pump/compressor: rated/normal/min flow, suction/discharge P, differential head, NPSHa, fluid properties, sparing, driver preference, operating cases.

items.name: Exchanger thermal design
items.content: EDR thermal design per exchanger: TEMA type, area, shells, passes, fouling, allowable/calculated dP, velocities, vibration check, air-cooler bays/fans.

items.name: Equipment process duties
items.content: Per equipment tag: service, type, duty/capacity, operating and design P/T, size, MoC recommendation, insulation, sparing.

items.name: Vessel and column process datasheets
items.content: Sketch, ID/T-T, levels, nozzle schedule with duties, internals, design/operating conditions, corrosion allowance basis, fluid data.

items.name: Tank process datasheets
items.content: Working/gross capacity, fill/draw rates, vapour pressure, breathing/emission data, blanketing, heating, mixer duty, levels.

items.name: Shell-and-tube and plate exchanger process datasheets
items.content: TEMA datasheet process part: duty, fluid allocation, flows, in/out T, properties, fouling, allowable dP, design P/T.

items.name: Air cooler process datasheets
items.content: Duty, process flows and properties, design air temperature, fan control requirement, winterisation, allowable dP.

items.name: Fired heater process datasheet
items.content: Absorbed duty per case, coil inlet/outlet conditions, vaporisation, allowable flux and film temperature, fuel composition, emission limits, turndown.

items.name: Pump process datasheets
items.content: Rated/normal/min flow, suction/discharge P, head, NPSHa, fluid properties, solids, operating cases, sealing considerations.

items.name: Compressor process datasheets
items.content: Gas composition per case, inlet/outlet P/T, flows, MW, k, Z, surge/turndown, settle-out pressure, control method.

items.name: Package process specifications
items.content: Per package: duty, feed and product specs, battery-limit P/T/flows, utility availability, turndown, process guarantees required.

items.name: Line sizing results
items.content: Per line: size, velocity, dP/100 m, rho-v2, two-phase flow regime, governing case, critical-line flags (slope, no pocket, two-phase).

items.name: P&IDs issued for review
items.content: IFR P&IDs: equipment, lines with sizes/spec breaks, valves, instruments, control and trip loops, notes and holds.

items.name: HAZOP-ready P&IDs
items.content: P&IDs issued for HAZOP with all relief, interlocks, set points, design P/T and holds listed, frozen revision for workshop.

items.name: Line process data
items.content: Per line: from/to, fluid code, phase, flow, operating/design P/T, test pressure basis, insulation and tracing requirement, critical-line flags.

items.name: Instrument process data
items.content: Per tag: fluid, phase, min/normal/max flow, P, T, density, viscosity, MW, vapour pressure, CV allowable dP and shut-off dP, level ranges, set points.

items.name: Control philosophy
items.content: Control strategy for throughput, quality, pressure and inventory; manual vs automatic; APC scope; alarm philosophy input.

items.name: Control narratives
items.content: Per loop group: measured/controlled variables, cascades, overrides, split-range, ratio and sequence logic, set points.

items.name: Trip and interlock schedule
items.content: Per trip: initiator tag, set point, voting preference, final elements and action, reset type, process safety time, bypass needs.

items.name: Operating philosophy
items.content: Operating modes, turndown, sparing, run length, start-up/shutdown approach, isolation and blinding philosophy, sampling.

items.name: Relief load summary
items.content: Per device: governing scenario, relief load, fluid composition, MW, T, Z, k, set and back pressure, coincident loads by scenario.

items.name: PSV process datasheets
items.content: Per PSV: set pressure, relieving rate, relieving conditions, fluid properties, required area and orifice letter, back pressure, discharge destination.

items.name: Flare network hydraulic results
items.content: Header and sub-header sizes, back pressure at each device, Mach and rho-v2, KO drum and flare tip loads per scenario.

items.name: Depressuring study results
items.content: Per segment: inventory, restriction orifice size, peak rate, minimum metal temperature, time to target pressure.

items.name: Utility consumption list
items.content: Per consumer: steam by level, cooling water, instrument/plant air, nitrogen, fuel gas, BFW, condensate return, power estimate; normal/peak/intermittent.

items.name: Utility system balances
items.content: Steam/condensate, CW, air, N2 and fuel gas balances per case with generator/user sizing requirements.

items.name: Chemical and catalyst consumption list
items.content: Per chemical/catalyst: service, dosing point, normal/max rate, first fill quantity, storage days, hazard class, replacement frequency.

items.name: Effluent and emissions data
items.content: Per source: flow, composition, temperature, frequency; CO2/NOx/SOx/VOC per point source and fugitive basis; solid/liquid waste quantities.

items.name: Release source and fluid data
items.content: Per isolatable section or release source: composition, P, T, phase, inventory, flash point, MW, toxic content (H2S), fluid category for HAC.

items.name: Process description and design report
items.content: Process description by section, design cases, key design decisions, deviations from basis, open items and assumptions.

items.name: HAZOP action responses (process)
items.content: Per action: response, design change made, P&ID reference, closure evidence, status.

items.name: P&ID markups from HAZOP
items.content: Clouded P&ID changes agreed in HAZOP/LOPA (new instruments, valves, relief, trips) for incorporation.

items.name: Process technical bid evaluation input
items.content: Per bidder: compliance with process duties, deviations, clarification questions, utility and performance comparison, acceptability.

items.name: Process comments on vendor data
items.content: Commented vendor documents with process review code, deviations, required changes and holds.

items.name: As-designed H&MB (vendor reconciled)
items.content: Final stream data and duties reflecting certified equipment, list of changed values affecting line list, instruments and relief.

items.name: Process TQ responses and hold releases
items.content: Per query/hold: answer, data value confirmed or revised, affected documents, release date.

items.name: Process comments on instrument datasheets
items.content: Comments on CV/FE/PSV/level instrument datasheets: data mismatches, rangeability, fail position, shut-off class.

items.name: Process 3D model review comments
items.content: Model review comments: slope/pocket violations, NPSH elevations, two-phase symmetry, PSV location, sample/drain access.

items.name: Tie-in process conditions
items.content: Per tie-in: fluid, operating/design P/T, flow, hot-tap feasibility from process view, isolation and purging requirement, shutdown dependency.

items.name: P&IDs issued for design
items.content: IFD P&IDs with HAZOP changes incorporated and remaining holds listed.

items.name: P&IDs issued for construction
items.content: IFC P&IDs, holds cleared, vendor data incorporated, approved for construction.

items.name: Process change impact assessment
items.content: Per change: affected streams, equipment, lines, relief and safety, rework estimate, need for HAZOP re-review.

items.name: Operating manual process input
items.content: Process description, operating limits and integrity operating windows, control and trip descriptions, sampling plan, troubleshooting guidance.

items.name: Process system boundary markups
items.content: P&IDs coloured by process system/subsystem with boundaries, isolation points and commissioning sequence preference.

items.name: Process commissioning requirements
items.content: Per system: cleaning/flushing method, drying and dew point, inerting and oxygen limits, run-in fluids, catalyst/chemical loading, first-fill list.

items.name: Start-up and shutdown procedures
items.content: Step-by-step initial and normal start-up, normal and emergency shutdown, with checkpoints, set points and hold points.

items.name: Process RFI responses and field change dispositions
items.content: Per RFI/field change: process answer, accept/reject, P&ID impact, need for MOC/HAZOP review.

items.name: Commissioning process punch and troubleshooting log
items.content: Process deficiencies found at commissioning, root cause, recommended change, set point adjustments, status.

items.name: Performance test procedure and report
items.content: Test conditions, measurements, sampling plan, correction methods, results vs guarantees, acceptance recommendation.

items.name: As-built P&IDs
items.content: As-built P&IDs and line process data reflecting field changes and commissioning modifications for handover.
